# Let me check the current X position and try clicking on the right panel top
def get_x_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'R':
            b = n['boundary']
            rmin, rmax = min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)
            cmin, cmax = min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)
            if rmax - rmin <= 2 and cmax - cmin <= 2 and rmin >= 28:
                grid_r = (rmin - 28) // 6
                grid_c = (cmin - 38) // 6
                return (grid_r, grid_c)
    return None

print(f"Current X pos: {get_x_pos()}")
